description: Hiring signals for a French company, derived on demand from France Travail data (snapshot under 24 h, nothing stored): actively-hiring yes/no/unprovable (null means absence is not provable), active-postings count (SIREN-keyed via France Travail's own employer page when one exists, else strict company-name matching over the company's known locations (lower bound: brand names and temp agencies not counted; the path used is stated in methode.comptage), top ROME occupation families (their total a lower bound when the detail is partial), contract-type mix, share of postings displaying a pay amount, plus the Egapro gender-equality index (every published year) and the INSEE workforce bracket. Aggregated signals only, never posting texts or recruiter contacts. Use for sales intelligence (a hiring company is an active company) and HR/expansion signals. A sole proprietorship, a restricted-diffusion entity or a group without legal personality (INSEE category 2xxx and categories 9200 (legacy association code), 9210 (undeclared association) and 0000 (collective investment undertaking)) answers 400 with its exact code and is never charged. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
